bottlenecks_identified: GATE SCHEMA CONTRACT MISMATCH (CRITICAL): Exp 987 succeeded functionally but emitted 'subprocess_propagation_ok' instead of 'env_propagation_persistent' in its artifact. Downstream gate configs checked 'env_propagation_persistent == True', received None, and blocked all 7 dependent experiments (criteria 2-6, 9, and Exp 994). This is the THIRD CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE with a single-upstream-artifact cascade block (.75: Exp 975 no artifact at all; .76: same; .77: wrong field name). Pattern: gate contracts not validated at design time against the artifact schema the upstream experiment actually writes.

LEGACY SLOW-5 CARRYOVERS — EXCLUSION MANIFEST UNAPPLIED (19TH CONSECUTIVE): Exps 786/627/641 remain in the slowest-5 for the 18th consecutive milestone despite retirement recommendations in every prior retro. Exp 986 preflight confirmed exclusion manifest entries are MISSING (YAML field not found). Cumulative waste across 18 milestones: ~2,304 min (38.4 hours). This is the dominant structural bottleneck. The fix is known, the manifest infrastructure exists, the change requires one YAML edit and a conductor restart.

DUALGPU IDLE — 12TH CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE: Both RTX 3090s (24 GB each) closed at 0% utilization (52C/52C). DualGPURunner was deployed in .66 (Exp 856, 1.979x throughput confirmed). It has never been wired into the production VerifyRepairPipeline. Cumulative foregone savings: ~720 min (12 hours) since deployment. At 626 experiments/milestone, parallel GPU utilization would reduce the GPU-bound subset duration by ~1.96x.

PLANNER PRIOR_FAILURES DISCIPLINE FAILURE: Exps 996 (GS-KAN) and 997 (NK Optimizer KAEM) were blocked by the conductor's rerun guard because the roadmap YAML lacked 'prior_failures' entries for tasks with documented failure histories. The conductor's mechanical enforcement is working correctly — but two milestone slots were consumed by experiments that were blocked at launch rather than producing results. The CLAUDE.md rule requiring prior_failures fields for re-proposed tasks must be applied at YAML authoring time, not discovered at conductor launch.

IMPROVEMENT IS NOT STRUCTURAL — COUNT-DRIVEN: The sixth consecutive improvement (-135 min, -4.22%) is accounted for almost entirely by the 22-experiment count reduction (-22 at 4.89 min/exp ≈ 108 min volume savings). No governance fix (manifest enforcement, DualGPU wiring, timeout caps) was applied. If experiment count stabilises or rises, the improvement streak will stall immediately.

KV260 SSH ACCESS BLOCKS FPGA FIRST LIGHT: Board discovered at 192.168.51.98 (confirmed across Exps 982, 993). Bitstream is ready (KV260 v4 RTL from .74). SCP transfer fails; board cannot be programmed autonomously. This is a human-action prerequisite (SSH key exchange from conductor host to kria@192.168.51.98), not a research task. It is blocking a milestone criterion that has been pending since the board arrived in .74.

EXP 998 ARXIV SCAN MISSING: Exp 998 produced no result artifact. Experiment either did not run or failed without a try/finally guard emitting a partial artifact. The try/finally mandate from CLAUDE.md is not universally enforced in experiment scripts.

COMPOSITION FREEZE RESUMED: Slowest-5 composition unchanged from .76 (Exps 786/627/641/906 + new entrant Exp 668 replacing Exp 603). Three legacy carryovers (786/627/641) maintain the 18-milestone appearance streak. The entry of Exp 668 (new research experiment) rather than structural governance action is what changed rank 5, not improvement in root causes.
improvements_suggested: GATE SCHEMA CONTRACT VALIDATION (immediate, high impact): Add a pre-launch check that compares each gate config's field path against the upstream experiment's declared artifact schema. Experiments must declare their output fields in a machine-readable schema block. The conductor rejects any gate config that references an undeclared field. Cost: ~2 hours of tooling; saves an entire milestone of blocked experiments per occurrence.

APPLY EXCLUSION MANIFEST FOR EXP 786/627/641 NOW: The manifest infrastructure exists. Exp 986 preflight confirmed entries are missing due to a YAML field lookup error. Fix the YAML field lookup and add entries for 786, 627, 641 before .78. This single change recovers 77+51+42 = 170 min/milestone (5.5% of total wall time) with zero research cost.

ADD EXP 906 TO MANDATORY EXCLUSION OR ROOT-CAUSE IT: Exp 906 is two milestones past the CLAUDE.md mandatory gate. Either (a) diagnose the SOTA GGUF pre-download root cause and implement pre-download before experiment launch, or (b) add 906 to exclusion manifest. Do not run in .78 without one of these actions completed.

WIRE DUALGPU INTO PRODUCTION PIPELINE: DualGPURunner has been idle for 12 consecutive milestones since deployment. Assign this as a dedicated, gated, no-research-dependency task in .78. At 1.96x throughput on GPU-bound experiments (~30% of total), this recovers ~60 min/milestone. No new tooling required — the runner is already implemented.

KV260 SSH KEY EXCHANGE (human action before .78 planning): Enable key-based SSH from the conductor host to kria@192.168.51.98. This unblocks FPGA first light, which has been one experiment away for three milestones. Treat as a human prerequisite to complete before the .78 milestone launches, not a research experiment.

FIX EXP 987 ARTIFACT FIELD NAME: Add 'env_propagation_persistent: true' to Exp 987's output artifact (or update .78 gate configs to use 'subprocess_propagation_ok' which IS set). This retroactively unblocks criteria 2-6 and 9 for .77 context and ensures .78 gates are not blocked by the same mismatch.

ADD PRIOR_FAILURES FOR GSKAN AND NK OPTIMIZER BEFORE .78 YAML IS AUTHORED: Exps 996 and 997 were blocked by missing prior_failures entries. The .78 planner must audit research-complete.yaml for all proposed tasks and add prior_failures entries before the YAML is submitted to the conductor.

ENFORCE TRY/FINALLY IN ALL EXPERIMENT SCRIPTS: Exp 998 produced no artifact. A try/finally guard must wrap every experiment's main() that writes artifacts, emitting at minimum a partial/blocked artifact with honest_verdict on any exception. Add this as a pre-commit hook check or experiment template enforcement.

SET HARD EXPERIMENT COUNT CAP AT 620: Current count (626) is below the 700 cap but only marginally. A hard cap of 620 provides headroom for planner prior_failures blocks without blowing the cap. Conductor should refuse to queue more than 620 experiments per milestone.

BATCH DOCUMENT RECONCILIATION PASSES: Doc reconciliation runs scattered through the milestone add overhead. Batch all doc updates into two passes: one at milestone start (status snapshot) and one at milestone close (retro + changelog). Estimated savings: 15-20 min/milestone.
structural_savings_note: Full structural savings (30%) require: exclusion manifest enforcement, DualGPU production wiring, gate schema contract validation, hard count cap, model pre-download pipeline. These are all known, designed, and unimplemented. No new research required.
